## #1 — ken — 2008-01-20
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/2594/post-17915>

Script hotkeys

I just realized that it's possible to bind scripts (or any other menu items) to hotkeys using OSX's keyboard and mouse preferences under "Application Keyboard Shortcuts". It opens up the use of modifier keys for shortcuts since C3D prefs don't allow for that. 

Sorry if that's old hat, but it's very useful to me!
